name: Lam Lam
source:
Like her father Sam, she has the ability to see things that are normally invisible to others.
At the age of 5, she was involved in an attempted kidnapping by Jing Ke's brothers.
Five years later, she was kidnapped again by criminals who had been released from prison, but was rescued by Yvet and others and survived.
After the incident, she was transferred from P.L.K. Leung Chow Shun Kam Primary School to PLK Choi Kai Yau School.
She was attached to Yvet, but her mother, Shilea, decided to keep her distance from Yvet.
She then skipped a grade and entered Faculty of Science, HKBU at the age of 17. She reunited with Yvet through Johnny and cooperated in the investigation of the Temple street terrorist attack.
